name: Okada Izou
source:
"No matter what, I can only use a sword."
A member of the Tosa clan that is loyal to the emperor and [url=/c43455]Takechi Hanpeita's[/url] disciple.
He's always smiling with a friendly look, but sometimes he can get the sharp look of an assassin in his eyes.
